specs.Compatible Devices: Smartphones, Tablets, Laptops, Desktops, Cars (with AUX or Bluetooth), TVs (with Bluetooth or AUX)

features: Dynamic bass: The ZEB-Thunder Max headphones allow you to fully enjoy exceptional audio, owing to the deep bass produced by the 40mm powerful drivers.

3 EQ modes: The headphones come with 3 EQ modes such as Sound Monster for bass boost, Vocal Enhancer for better vocal experience, and Equalizer for balanced output to customize your listening experience. For seamless switching between the EQ modes, double tap on the Play/pause button.
Gaming mode: Focus on your game with the ZEB-Thunder Max headphones as it is curated to offer a low-latency gaming experience.
Connectivity: Enabling wireless connection using BT v5.4, this headphone performs wonderfully. Also, you can connect the audio source to headphones using an AUX.
Comfortability: For the greatest comfort, these ergonomically designed lightweight headphones have soft ear cushions.
